set.body: Lifecycle bd-01M3DPFH6R59EZAHADBN10VSJA server slice. Existing share intentionally copies last-saved science and cannot implement Save As. Add a current-session copy into an empty locked destination, retain stored inputs/native archive bytes/live undo, save destination manifest last, keep source saved/edited state unchanged. Reject same/busy/nonempty destinations and failed copies as values; release destination writer on failure. Native chooser/window switch and Open Recent remain separate follow-ups.
set.title: Save As: copy current session graph and undo history without changing the source
